project.description: The bay's land drawn anew on the terrain (terrain-core), beside the land the engine lays, until the whole bay moves over to it: its ground level, the sea, the bay and the river dredged, the gardens' lakes dug, as made works; its water and its land as land features; written out as a country's text, for any terrain bench to draw. From the bay's own lines (bay-land), derived from OpenStreetMap (map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), and so licensed.
